title: DARK HORSE: Mass Hero Entry BGM (original score)
description:
Nobody saw him coming. One lone instrument in the dark, then the whole world shakes: the hero walks in, slow motion, and the crowd turns.

A dark, heavy mass hero entry theme: a deep 808 bass that hits like a wall, processed synth stabs, a mridangam and veena underneath, a male chant answering the hook and a three-hit ending, written in South Indian film style. Use it for hero intros, attitude edits, slow-motion walks and mass reels. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Dark Horse, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
